crew.overview: After suspecting that their police officer neighbor is a serial killer, a group of teenage friends spend their summer spying on him and gathering evidence, but as they get closer to discovering the truth, things get dangerous.
crew.title: Summer of 84

crew.overview: Tragedy strikes when a woman named Joyce's son falls through the ice on a frozen lake and is trapped underwater for over 15 minutes. After being rushed to the hospital, the 14-year-old boy continues to fight for his life as Joyce, her husband and their pastor stay by his bedside and pray for a miracle.
crew.title: Breakthrough

details.biography: Kathy grew up in Vancouver BC area and graduated from North Delta Sr. Secondary school, landing her first stunt job at 15 years old on The Stepfather, playing a girl who got bullied and beat up at school. She landed this role due to her Judo background, being multiple-time Canadian Champion in her sport therefore able to take a few hits to the ground. After dabbling in stunts throughout her teens, while travelling the world and competing with Team Canada, Kathy quit judo just before the '92 Olympics and turned her attention full-time to stunt-work, landing a key-role in Rumble in the Bronx with Jackie Chan. She landed this role because of her motorcycle racing background, and this blockbuster release saw her riding a motocross bike over 20 cars and set her career off after that. Kathy has enjoyed a long career in the stunt-industry and has recently returned to her roots, just having won the Judo Masters World Championships and Brazilian Jiu-jitsu Masters World Championships. Kathy has been a Stunt Coordinator in many shows as well, most of them having been filmed in her current hometown of Kelowna, BC.
details.name: Kathy Hubble
